steps.title: Add New Lock.
steps.copy: Open LAAS and tap Add New Lock on the welcome screen. Allow Bluetooth access when your phone asks.

steps.title: Enter the serial number.
steps.copy: Stand beside your lock and enter the 8-digit serial number printed on it.

steps.title: Name your lock.
steps.copy: Give your lock a name, then tap Continue.

steps.title: Line it up.
steps.copy: Hold the lock against the mounting holes. Choose the bracket slots that leave room above the tyre.

steps.title: Put in the screws.
steps.copy: Put the supplied screws through the brackets and into the frame.

steps.title: Tighten and check.
steps.copy: Centre the lock and tighten the screws with a 4 mm hex key. Check that the lock clears the tire.

flex-mounting.title: My bike has no mounting holes.

steps.title: Attach the brackets.
steps.copy: Put the metal nuts in the bracket slots. Screw the brackets loosely onto the lock. Leave room to adjust.

steps.title: Bend the strips.
steps.copy: Gently bend the plastic strips around the frame.

steps.title: Wrap around the frame.
steps.copy: Wrap the strips around the frame. Fit the plastic screws and tighten them lightly with a flathead screwdriver.

steps.title: Align and tighten.
steps.copy: Centre the lock and leave room above the tyre. Tighten the screws that hold the lock, then the screws on the strips.

steps.title: Trim the strips.
steps.copy: Trim the excess with pliers or a knife. Check that the lock is secure.

steps.title: Press three times.
steps.copy: Press the button on the side of your lock three times.

steps.title: Look for the blinking light.
steps.copy: The LED blinks. Pairing mode stays active for ten minutes.

steps.title: Open Apple Find My.
steps.copy: On your iPhone or iPad, open Find My. Go to Items, tap +, then Add Other Item.

steps.title: Connect your lock.
steps.copy: Select Ring-Lock when it appears, tap Connect, then follow the steps to name it.

steps.title: Open sharing.
steps.copy: Open your lock’s sharing controls in LAAS.

steps.title: Choose access.
steps.copy: Choose Guest or Owner and add a name or note so you know who the invitation is for.

steps.title: Send the link.
steps.copy: Tap Share and send the invitation in a message.

steps.title: They accept.
steps.copy: They open the link and accept it in LAAS. No account is needed.

steps.title: See your locks.
steps.copy: See your locks and their battery levels in LAAS.

steps.title: Open Settings.
steps.copy: Use Settings to manage your lock groups and preferences.

steps.title: Update when prompted.
steps.copy: When the app offers a firmware update, follow the instructions on screen.

steps.title: Open LAAS.
steps.copy: Stand beside your bike and open the LAAS app.

steps.title: Tap Unlock.
steps.copy: Tap Unlock in the LAAS app.

steps.title: Check it is open.
steps.copy: Make sure the shackle is fully open before you ride.
